messages.subject: Loading a resource from a jar - ClassLoader issue
messages.subject_clean: Loading a resource from a jar - ClassLoader issue
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I'm developing a java gui app and run it from R using rJava. For the GUI 
i want use the Substance LookAndFeel library 
(https://substance.dev.java.net/). I set the L&F the usual way:

UIManager.setLookAndFeel(new SubstanceOfficeSilver2007LookAndFeel());

It works if i run as normal java app but it fails when i run it from R 
using rJava. It throws a NullPointerException. I examined the problem 
and found that it can't load a resource 
("org/pushingpixels/substance/api/skin/office2007.colorschemes") in the 
substance.jar. Substance tries to load this resource from the 
ClassLoader but the issue is how it gets the ClassLoader.

    /**
      * Returns the class loader for loading the resource files. It is a 
fix by
      * Dag Joar and Christian Schlichtherle for application running with
      * -Xbootclasspath VM flag. In this case, the using
      * MyClass.class.getClassLoader() would return null, but the 
context class
      * loader will function properly that classes will be properly loaded
      * regardless of whether the lib is added to the system class path, the
      * extension class path and regardless of the class loader 
architecture set
      * up by some frameworks.
      *
      * @return The class loader for loading the resource files.
      */
     public static ClassLoader getClassLoaderForResources() {
         ClassLoader cl = (ClassLoader) UIManager.get("ClassLoader");
         if (cl == null)
             cl = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
         return cl;
     }

Above is the code to get the ClassLoader. The cl is an instance of 
sun.misc.Launcher$AppClassLoader. This classloader can't find the 
resource "org/pushingpixels/substance/api/skin/office2007.colorschemes", 
although the javadoc of the method states that it works for any case. 
However MyClass.class.getClassLoader() works, which is RJavaClassLoader.

While substance is open source, i can solve this problem by changing the 
code. But if it can be solved in rJava, of cource it would be the superior.

best wishes,
ilhami visne

messages.subject_clean: [rJava] error installing rJava using IBM Java
messages.body_plain:
On Jun 29, 2010, at 3:13 AM, Mary Auclair wrote:

> Hi Simon,
> 
> When I originally ran the install, I executed R CMD INSTALL
> rJava_0.8-5.tar.gz.  This created a temp directory for the rjava install and
> the config.log was deleted.  
> 
> So I had to re-run the install to get the config.log file. This time I ran
> tar zxvf rJava_0.8-5.tar.gz and then ran R CMD INSTALL rJava.
> 
> Please find the attached file for config.log
> 

Great, thanks. Your JDK requires additional -ldl as it appears (see the missing symbols). Try setting

JAVA_HOME=/opt/ibm/java-x86_64-60
export JAVA_LIBS="-L${JAVA_HOME}/jre/lib/amd64/default -L${JAVA_HOME}/jre/lib/amd64 -L/usr/lib -ljvm -ldl"

and then re-run 

sudo R CMD javareconf

Cheers,
Simon
